text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
Here are the Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) ticket numbers I found in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from *Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth* (5 Oct 2025, `dev/agent-notes/2025-10-05-north-sunday`). Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 about gatehouse kiosk SMS bay assignments at the Eau Claire yard. The note says support patched it and the 5 Oct shift cleared. It also appears in the action items for 6 Oct.
2. **#4419**, from *Moss: North cheat sheet* (undated, `dev/agent-notes/north-account-cheatsheet`). Thea logged it for gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The same note says it was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing.
3. **#4419**, from *Moss: Q2 expansion wrap (belated)* (14 Jul 2025, `dev/notes/2025-07-14-marcus-q2-expansion-wrap`). Marcus wrote it, and it lists the same number as "Gate 3 printer lag," a BOL printout delay. The description doesn't match item 2, so the number may have been reused or one of the notes may be wrong. Worth checking in the ticket system before it goes into the weekly notes.

Moss's other QFL notes (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) don't mention a ticket number. I left out the ticket numbers #4409 and #4412 from the 2 Jan 2026 Central handoffs note. They belong to a different account (Pree's dealer account at Salina North), not QFL. I also skipped "Quarendon Freightways," which the cheat sheet notes is a different company.

The search was keyword-only, so there could be QFL ticket numbers in notes it didn't match. I can't rule that out.
